g.text: Both temp inputs work as DS18B20 (1-wire) or as 10k NTC (ADC, 4.7k reference) - see README.

g.desc: Both temp inputs work as DS18B20 (1-wire) or as 10k NTC (ADC, 4.7k reference) - see README.

g.text: PSU ATX 24-pin plug -> J1. 5VSB feeds the 5V rail and U2 (3V3) at all times; VBUS only through D1.

g.desc: PSU ATX 24-pin plug -> J1. 5VSB feeds the 5V rail and U2 (3V3) at all times; VBUS only through D1.

g.text: BC250 Front Controller - ESP32-S3 PCBA (fully assembled at JLCPCB)

g.desc: BC250 Front Controller - ESP32-S3 PCBA (fully assembled at JLCPCB)

g.text: Hand-soldered by the user (not in the JLCPCB BOM): U1 module, J2 socket, LED1. Everything else is Economic-assembly eligible.

g.desc: Hand-soldered by the user (not in the JLCPCB BOM): U1 module, J2 socket, LED1. Everything else is Economic-assembly eligible.

g.text: J2: ST7789 module on pins 1-8, or SSD1306 OLED on pins 1-4 (GND VCC SCL SDA). J7 = external WS2812 in parallel with LED1.

g.desc: J2: ST7789 module on pins 1-8, or SSD1306 OLED on pins 1-4 (GND VCC SCL SDA). J7 = external WS2812 in parallel with LED1.

g.text: PWR_OK 5V -> R2/R3 -> GPIO5. T1 on GPIO7 (R4 pull-up); T2 on GPIO7 via JP1 1-2 (default) or GPIO2 via JP1 2-3 (R5).

g.desc: PWR_OK 5V -> R2/R3 -> GPIO5. T1 on GPIO7 (R4 pull-up); T2 on GPIO7 via JP1 1-2 (default) or GPIO2 via JP1 2-3 (R5).

g.text: GPIO4 LOW -> PSU off. Same polarity as the relay-module wiring: keep relay_inverted: "true" in the yaml.

g.desc: GPIO4 LOW -> PSU off. Same polarity as the relay-module wiring: keep relay_inverted: "true" in the yaml.

g.text: Q1 pulls PS_ON low (PSU ON) while GPIO4 is HIGH or floating (R1 pull-up) -> PSU stays on when the ESP32 is dead.

g.desc: Q1 pulls PS_ON low (PSU ON) while GPIO4 is HIGH or floating (R1 pull-up) -> PSU stays on when the ESP32 is dead.
